name: codex-blender
description: Inspect authorized Blender projects, render reversible preview videos, and produce Jimeng links by driving the official jimeng_blender_uploader add-on headlessly.

interface.shortDescription: Headless Jimeng preview render and upload for Blender
interface.longDescription: Drives the official Jimeng/Seedance Blender add-on without its UI: inspects a scene, renders a reversible preview from a camera, and produces a ready-to-open Jimeng link for the rendered or an existing video.
defaultPrompt: Render a white-model preview of this Blender scene and link it to Jimeng
Make a Jimeng link from this preview video
